summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the sale of its wholly-owned subsidiary Ohmyhome (BVI) Ltd to Sterling Oat Ltd for $1. The board approved the divestiture after the target had negative net assets of $14.77M. The transaction closed on May 31, 2026. The price was nominal due to the subsidiary's weak financials; no premium applicable. The company exits real estate brokerage services to focus on digital marketing. No advisors named. Divestiture mechanics involve a share purchase agreement. The debt waiver of SGD 19M preceded the sale. Watch for the company's future performance in its new digital marketing focus.
